summary: Tested the two-tier paywall end to end, backend and UI. Backend: 18 pytest checks, all passed. They covered lock and tier states for the 24 items, 402 on paid items for a free user, 403 sequence locks, the quote math for all codes, a real Stripe test checkout URL with a pending status, 100% code grants, admin code CRUD and 403 for non-admins, admin video save with Vimeo-only validation, video URLs hidden from free users, section and final unlocks, the pastor gate on A7, and master results. The full journey also passed in the UI. Free user: dashboard tier sections with 6 padlocks; paywall title and $40.00; EarlyAdopters shows a struck $40.00 and $20.00; checkout redirects to checkout.stripe.com; A1 lands on /congrats/initial; chapter 1 lands on /chapter/1 with the headline, a locked video with an unlock button, Spread the Word (goes to the /spread-the-word draft) and Join the Conversation (opens the paywall). Paid user: TLG Staff turns the button into Unlock Now, shows a toast and clears the padlocks; the pastor gate's Continue to Questions shows 25 questions; submit goes to the result page; /master-results shows the table (Day 1 75, Today 125), 5 section reviews and 17 chapter reviews. Admin: /admin/codes create, edit, toggle and delete all work; /admin/videos shows a friendly error for a non-Vimeo URL and saves. Header heights were measured at 3 widths.

minor.issue: stripe.Price.list(...).data[0] and Session.create have no error handling. A missing price lookup_key or any StripeError gives an unhandled 500 instead of a friendly message.
success_url and cancel_url are built from the client-supplied origin_url (open redirect). Prefer FRONTEND_URL from env, or check against an allowlist.
No auth or ownership check (anyone with a session id can poll it). Low risk.
Replaces the whole videos map, so a partial payload wipes the other keys. The admin UI sends the full map, so the UI is unaffected.

issues: Measured header height (including the gold bottom border) is 148px at 1920, 98px at 900 and 77px at 390. The target was about 138px at 1920. The logo is 83/58/48px and the byline is 20.8/14.4/12px, so it scales correctly; it is just about 10px taller than the target at desktop. No horizontal overflow.

Free users get no 'Next Rep' or back-to-dashboard button, only Spread the Word and Join the Conversation. The only way to the next chapter is the header Dashboard link. Consider adding a secondary 'Back to Dashboard' link.
The Vimeo iframe (player.vimeo.com/video/76979871) showed 'Player error' in headless Chromium. Probably a headless/DRM limitation; check in a real browser.

action_items: Wrap the Stripe calls in /payments/checkout in try/except (IndexError and stripe.error.StripeError) and return a 502/400 with a friendly message
Build Stripe success/cancel URLs from FRONTEND_URL rather than client origin_url
Optional: add a Dashboard link on the free-user chapter completion page
Optional: trim the header to about 138px at desktop if that target is strict
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 805 lines; consider splitting the paywall, payments and videos code into a router module
Each checkout click inserts a new pending payment_transactions row; old pending rows are never cleaned up unless the Stripe webhook expires them
